_comment: Group -> destination folder WITHIN each structure (keyed by the master sub-folder name, e.g. 'Construction', 'M&ELite'). Group codes are OHS/ENV/QUAL/IMS (from departments.json form_folders). A form is filed into its mapped folder if that folder exists in the recreated structure; otherwise it falls back to '05 Forms (Populated)/<group>'. Add ENV/IMS homes or new structures here without touching code. Paths must match the folder names inside the master structure exactly.
